E.headline: ChatGPT accuracy lies between typical and ASD groups; GPT-3.5 trails typical adults on emotion attribution; both LLMs answer verbosely.

G.notes: Single administration per model through the chat interface; no temperature, repeats or prompt variants. Classic published items in Italian, likely in training data. EAT scored after an extra prompt. Binomial tests treat group proportions as fixed. Data available only on request. Human groups unbalanced by sex; separate TD groups per task.
